o.text: By surface analysis, baş + -qa. Compare özgə (“other”), derived from öz using the same suffix. Compare Turkish başka, Turkmen başga.
Internationalism. From Russian артилле́рия (artillérija), itself from French artillerie.
Borrowed from Classical Persian دائمی (dā'imī / dâ'emi), a pseudo-Arabism from the root د و م (d w m).
Borrowed from Arabic يَوْم الأَحَد (yawm al-ʔaḥad).
From Proto-Turkic *sīd-. Compare Turkmen siýmek, dialectal Turkish siymek (“to urinate”)
